image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a white daisy flower. The image focuses on the bright yellow central disc composed of many tiny florets and the surrounding ring of white ray petals. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green, suggesting foliage, with hints of other daisies in the bokeh.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out look-alikes like chamomile or aster based on petal count and disc structure.
To analyze the micro-texture of the central disc florets for any signs of AI smearing or repetitive pattern artifacts.
To check for edge bleeding between the white petals and the green background, a common artifact in generated floral images.

focus_areas: Texture consistency of the yellow central disc (granular vs. smooth/melted)
Edge sharpness and separation of white petals against the blurred background
Symmetry and natural variation in petal shape (avoiding perfect geometric repetition)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the yellow disc and the white petals. AI models often struggle with this boundary, causing color bleeding or structural fusion. Also, verify that the 'granular' texture of the center looks like distinct biological units rather than noise or a repeated stamp pattern.
